entities.name: Query GlmU-like protein
observations: 449 aa soluble enzyme candidate; predicted molecular mass 46.99 kDa and pI 6.51.
Matches reviewed GlmU homologs at 55.6–58.4% identity with 96.9–99.8% query coverage and E-values of 3.4e-152 to 9.9e-162.
Homology supports a bifunctional enzyme catalyzing the final two steps of UDP-N-acetylglucosamine biosynthesis.
N-terminal region is associated with UDP-GlcNAc pyrophosphorylase activity; C-terminal region is associated with glucosamine-1-phosphate N-acetyltransferase activity.
Predicted Pfam matches include NTP_transferase/NTP_transf_3 in the N-terminal region; the C-terminal acetyltransferase assignment is supported primarily by full-length homology.
Likely cytosolic and trimeric by analogy to reviewed GlmU homologs; these are homology-based inferences for the query.
